name: skills
description:
Manage the skill catalog and load skills into the current session. Replaces the legacy `skill` + `list_skills` tools.

Approval policy: read actions (`find`, `get`) auto-approve; write actions (`create`, `update`, `enable`, `disable`) require approval AND the `model.skills.write` permission on the session user — default-ungranted, operators opt themselves in via the Roles tab.

Actions:
- `find`: list skills filtered by `category`, `tag`, `risk_level`, `kind`, `enabled_only`, `limit`, with optional BM25 `query` over the filtered set. Returns a hint when filters yield 0 rows showing what an unfiltered query would have matched.
- `get`: fetch a single skill by `name`, returning the full row including `content` — inspect before `update`.
- `load` (requires approval): activate a skill by `name` on the current session — replaces the current skill and applies its session config. Works on both interactive and coordinator sessions; `kind` is authored audience metadata, not an enforcement gate. To assign a skill to a *child* workstream instead, use `spawn_workstream(skill=...)`.
- `create`/`update`: author or patch a skill by `name` with `content`, `description`, and optional config fields. `enable`/`disable`: flip the `enabled` flag — disabled skills stay in storage, are hidden from `find` unless `enabled_only=false`, and are rejected by `load` / `spawn_workstream(skill=...)`. Storage authoritatively re-computes `risk_level` from the scanner — caller cannot lie.

Soft-delete only — there is no `delete` action in this tool. Hard-delete remains admin-UI exclusive to avoid model-proposed mistakes against in-use skills.

arguments.description: For `load`: optional invocation arguments for SKILL.md `$ARGUMENTS` / `$N` / `$<name>` substitution in the skill body. Free-form string parsed with shell-style quoting via `shlex.split` (quotes stripped). Skills declaring `arguments: [issue, branch]` in their frontmatter expose `$issue` and `$branch` bound by position. Omit or pass an empty string when the skill has no `$ARGUMENTS`/`$N`/`$<name>` placeholders; `${TURNSTONE_SESSION_ID}` / `${TURNSTONE_EFFORT}` env-var substitution (with `${CLAUDE_*}` accepted as a back-compat alias) still runs regardless.

query.description: For `find`: optional BM25 query over name + description + tags + category. Omit to return rows by filters alone.

category.description: For `find` (filter) and `create`/`update` (field): category string. Free-form, e.g. 'engineering', 'ops', 'data'.

tag.description: For `find`: filter by a single tag. The tag must appear in the skill's `tags` array.

tags.description: For `create`/`update`: list of tag strings. Stored as a JSON array.

risk_level.description: For `find` (filter): filter by scanner-assigned tier. Note: risk_level is NEVER caller-controlled on writes — the storage layer recomputes it from the scanner on every create/update. The field shown here is read-only output of the scanner.

enabled_only.description: For `find`: when true, return only enabled skills. Default false (include disabled rows so callers can see what's available to enable).

limit.description: For `find`: max rows to return (1-500, default 100). Truncation is signaled in the response.

content.description: For `create` (required) / `update` (optional): the skill's prompt body. Max 32768 chars. Storage runs the scanner against this content to assign `risk_level`.

description.description: For `create` (required) / `update` (optional): one-line summary shown in discovery output. Max 1024 chars, must not be empty.

kind.description: Authored audience metadata — passive marker, not an enforcement boundary. For `create`/`update`: which surface this skill was authored for; defaults to `any`. For `find`: pass `interactive` or `coordinator` to narrow the browse (`any`-tagged rows included); omit for all kinds.

model.description: For `create`/`update`: model alias to use when this skill is active (overrides session default).

temperature.description: For `create`/`update`: temperature when this skill is active. Range 0-2 or null.

reasoning_effort.description: For `create`/`update`: reasoning_effort override when this skill is active.

max_tokens.description: For `create`/`update`: max_tokens override when this skill is active. Positive integer or null.

token_budget.description: For `create`/`update`: per-turn token budget when this skill is active. 0 = no override.

agent_max_turns.description: For `create`/`update`: sub-agent turn cap when this skill is active. Positive integer or null.

auto_approve.description: For `create`/`update`: when this skill is loaded into a session, mark its session as auto-approving tools in `allowed_tools` without operator prompt. Operator-visible on the approval card; use sparingly.

allowed_tools.description: For `create`/`update`: tools auto-approved when this skill is active. Empty / absent = none (operator approves each call). Editing forces a scanner re-run that may shift `risk_level` — diff shown on the approval card.

activation.description: For `create`/`update`: how the skill becomes discoverable. `named` = explicit load only; `default` = applies to every new session; `search` = listed in the search-activated catalog.

notify_on_complete.description: For `create`/`update`: list of notify targets to fire when a workstream using this skill completes.
